title: 第19章 暴动第20章 死里逃生
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 希娅紧握着林鬼的手，掌心因为紧张而沁出细密的汗珠。
她将自己的游侠隐匿技巧发挥到极致。
几个低阶的【气息遮蔽】、【光影扭曲】法术被她熟练地施加在两人身上。
在阿卡拉大陆，武者学习一些实用的辅助魔法是常态。
就像法师，也会锻炼体魄学习近战技巧一样，这并不稀奇。
她的身形在林木的阴影间时隐时现。
如同鬼魅，每一次落脚都轻若鸿毛。
小心地规避着地面上可能发出声响的枯枝败叶。
距离那沉睡的庞然巨物越来越近。
空气中弥漫的硫磺味和恶魔特有的威压几乎令人窒息。
希娅的心脏狂跳得像要挣脱胸腔。
上一次与这只恶魔遭遇的恐怖记忆，如潮水般涌上。
那濒死的绝望感，让她四肢都有些发软。
她知道，再往前一步，就可能踏破那无形的界限，惊醒这头恐怖的传奇恶魔。
就在她几乎要被恐惧压垮，脚步迟疑的瞬间，一只手稳稳地拽住了她。
她愕然转头，看向林鬼。
出乎她意料的是，林鬼的脸上竟看不到丝毫紧张，只有一种近乎冷漠的平静。
仿佛眼前不是传奇恶魔，而只是一块碍路的石头。
“好了，到这里就够了。”
林鬼轻声说道，声音平稳得不像话。
“接下来，施展你最强的隐匿魔法，然后……相信我。”
希娅下意识地照做，将自己压箱底的精灵隐匿法术也加持而上。
与此同时，林鬼抽出了他那根看似朴素的橡木法杖。
低沉而迅疾的吟唱声开始响起。
那咒语复杂而古怪，音节拗口。
流淌出的魔力波动晦涩难明，完全不似常见的魔法体系。
远处，一直紧盯着他们的里昂皱紧了眉头，低声问身旁那位超凡法师。
“他在施展什么法术？能看出来吗？”
那位法师凝神感知了片刻，脸上露出极其古怪和困惑的神情。
他张了张嘴，像是便秘一样艰难地说道。
“这……波动很奇特……有点像三环的【黑夜术】”
“但又掺杂了【影藏术】的架构，还有……我也说不准，从未感知过这种形式的魔力构建……”
他最终无奈地摇头，无法判断。
就在林鬼吟唱声达到一个尖锐的顶点，又骤然停止的瞬间。
他猛地转头，神情是前所未有的严肃，对脸色发白的希娅快速说道：
“抱紧我！”
“什么？”
希娅一时没反应过来。
“快！抱紧我！越紧越好！”
content_en:
Shia held Lin Gui's hand tightly, and there were beads of sweat on her palms due to her nervousness.
She puts her ranger stealth skills to the best of her abilities.
She skillfully cast several low-level [Aura Masking] and [Light and Shadow Distortion] spells on the two of them.
In the continent of Akala, it is normal for warriors to learn some practical auxiliary magic.
Just like mages, it is not uncommon for them to train their bodies and learn melee combat skills.
Her figure appeared and disappeared in the shadows of the trees.
Like a ghost, every time he lands he is as light as a feather.
Carefully avoid dead branches and leaves on the ground that may make noise.
Getting closer and closer to the sleeping giant.
The smell of sulfur and the devil's unique pressure in the air was almost suffocating.
Shia's heart was beating so fast that it felt like it was breaking out of her chest.
The terrifying memories of the last encounter with this demon came flooding back.
The desperate feeling of dying made her limbs feel weak.
She knew that if she took another step forward, she might break through the invisible boundary and awaken this terrifying legendary demon.
Just when she was almost overwhelmed by fear and hesitated in her steps, a hand held her firmly.
She turned her head in shock and looked at Lin Gui.
To her surprise, there was no trace of nervousness on Lin Gui's face, only an almost indifferent calmness.
It was as if the legendary demon was not in front of him, but just a stone blocking the way.
"Okay, that's enough."
Lin Gui said softly, his voice was too steady to be true.
"Next, use your strongest concealment magic, and then... trust me."
Shia subconsciously followed the instructions and added the elf concealment spell she had pressed to the bottom of the box.
At the same time, Lin Kuei drew out his seemingly simple oak staff.
A low and rapid chant began to sound.
The spell was complicated and weird, and the syllables were difficult to pronounce.
The fluctuations of magic power flowing out are obscure and difficult to understand, and they are completely unlike common magic systems.
In the distance, Leon, who had been staring at them closely, frowned and asked the extraordinary mage next to him in a low voice.
"What spell is he casting? Can you tell?"
The mage concentrated for a moment, with an extremely strange and confused look on his face.
He opened his mouth and spoke with difficulty as if he was constipated.
"This... fluctuation is very strange... a bit like the three-ring [Dark Night Technique]"
"But it is mixed with the structure of [Shadow Hidden Technique], and...I can't say for sure, I have never experienced this form of magic construction..."
He finally shook his head helplessly, unable to judge.
At the moment when the Lin Gui's chant reached a sharp peak, it suddenly stopped.
He turned his head sharply, his expression was more serious than ever before, and said quickly to Shia who turned pale:
"Hold me tight!"
"What?"
Sia didn't react for a moment.
"Quick! Hold me tight! The tighter the better!"
